text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having parted ways with Satono Diamond 
after running side by side for so long, 
Kitasan Black was noticeably out of sorts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her seniors, Tokai Teio and Nice Nature, 
rush over out of concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After discussing who would be best to 
learn from, it was decided they would 
study under Tokai Teio, Mejiro McQueen, 
and the others.
